repositories.verified_scope: Algebraic Schur-Weyl decomposition with genuine injective Specht labels, literal Hom multiplicity spaces, simple and pairwise nonisomorphic multiplicities, and all-vector equivariance for both commuting actions. Characteristic zero algebraically closed field and finite-dimensional base module are the substantive ambient assumptions.
repositories.historical_status_note: Older issue #5326 reports a vacuous partition decomposition. Current inspected Corollary5_19_2 and SchurWeylPartition explicitly replace that construction. Do not present the historical issue as evidence that the current theorem is vacuous.

No global finite-dimensional assumption is imposed.
